what: Reference values for the special functions in src/kernel/blkt.mjs, from mpmath at 40 digits.
why: The JS implementations are hand-rolled -- a digamma asymptotic series, a continued fraction for E_1, a downward recurrence for Gamma(-2, x). Holding them to values typed from memory is holding them to nothing: the first version of the harness carried a wrong 'tabulated' E_1(5) and the JS was the half that was right. These come from an instrument that shares no code with ours.

potential_integral.note: int_0^L dl l exp(-x^2/l) = x^4 Gamma(-2, x^2/L), which is what their (4.2) integrates
